review.note: kascov's own reduced vector, compiled from contracts/kcc0020_vector.sil with silverc e8a7762. Spec-shaped, deliberately NOT conformant: owner schemes p2pk and p2sh only, and one extension class per family, so cross-class shapes are rejected by the program rather than merely unvalidated. Reviewed 2026-08-24 on three legs. Source to bytes: both committed sentinels recompile byte-identically from the source with the pinned compiler. Bytes to chain: the leader reveal fetched from a public testnet-10 node carries template halves identical to the sentinels, so the program running on chain is the program in this repository. Behaviour: the compiled program was exercised by the real Kaspa script engine on every rule this pin declares, and the engine itself rejected cross-class families, a successor class no input carries, a minting family total, a forged hash-chain preimage, a stale guard, a threshold-equal delta, a reduced KAS floor, a foreign owner signature, a delegator posing as leader and an invalid path byte. The live ladder on testnet-10 (covenant 94d927e08ecdcf8833c012aba39961ac3d07d42051870205b8db946b95633109) is that same program accepted by consensus.
